title: Crevalcore train crash.
text: The Crevalcore train crash was a major railway accident which occurred on 7 January 2005 on the Verona–Bologna railway, Italy, killing 17. It was one of the worst crashes in the recent history of the state railway company Ferrovie dello Stato.

title: Murders of Aldo Donegani and Luisa De Leo.
text: The murders of Aldo Donegani and Luisa De Leo, known in Italian as the Omicidio dei coniugi Donegani, is a notorious double homicide case in Italy. It occurred in the summer of 2005, and had started with the disappearance of the elderly couple 77-year-old Aldo Donegani and his wife 61-year-old Luisa De Leo.
wiki: Murders of Aldo Donegani and Luisa De Leo

title: Eurostar 9410 derailment.
text: The Eurostar 9410 derailment was a minor railroad accident that occurred in Bari, Apulia, Italy, on 24 October 2005. While causing no deaths, it left 30 wounded and five critically injured.

title: “Do They Know It's Christmas?” by Band Aid 20
text: "Do They Know It's Christmas?" is a charity song written in 1984 by Bob Geldof and Midge Ure to raise money for the 1983–1985 famine in Ethiopia. It was first recorded by Band Aid, a supergroup consisting of popular British and Irish musicians, in a single day at Sarm West Studios in Notting Hill, London, in November 1984.

title: “Cleptomania” by Sugarfree
text: Sugarfree is an Italian pop-rock band formed in 2000, best known for the song "Cleptomania".

title: “Get Right” by Jennifer Lopez
text: "Get Right" is a song by American singer Jennifer Lopez for her fourth studio album, Rebirth. It was written by Rich Harrison and James Brown, and produced by Harrison and Cory Rooney.

title: “Angelo” by Francesco Renga
text: "Angelo" is a 2005 song co-written and performed by Francesco Renga. It won the 55th edition of the Sanremo Music Festival.

title: “Army of Lovers” by 22 July
text: "Army of Lovers" is the debut single of Blue member Lee Ryan, released from his debut solo album, Lee Ryan, on 18 July 2005. The song peaked at number three on the UK Singles Chart and achieved success worldwide, reaching number one in Italy and staying there for four weeks.

title: “The Importance of Being Idle” by 26 August
text: "The Importance of Being Idle" is a song by English rock band Oasis. It was released on 22 August 2005 in the UK as the second single from their sixth studio album, Don't Believe the Truth, written, produced, and sung by lead guitarist Noel Gallagher.
listen: The Importance of Being Idle 26 August

title: “La Camisa Negra” by Juanes
text: "La Camisa Negra" is a Spanish rock song written by Juanes, inspired by Colombian singer-songwriter Octavio Mesa and recorded by Juanes for his third studio album Mi Sangre.

title: “La nostra vita” by Eros Ramazzotti
text: Eros Walter Luciano Ramazzotti is an Italian pop and rock singer, songwriter and record producer. He is popular in Italy and most European countries, and throughout the Spanish-speaking world, as he has released most of his albums in both Italian and Spanish.

title: “Precious” by 30 September
text: "Precious" is a song by English electronic music band Depeche Mode from their eleventh studio album, Playing the Angel. It was released on 3 October 2005 by Mute, Sire, and Reprise Records as the album's lead single.

title: “Tripping” by Robbie Williams
text: "Tripping" is a song by British singer Robbie Williams from his sixth studio album Intensive Care. The single was released as the album's lead single on 3 October 2005 through Chrysalis Records.

title: “Big City Life” by Mattafix
text: "Big City Life" is a song by English electronic music duo Mattafix. With a chorus sung in Jamaican Patois, "Big City Life" was released in August 2005 as the second single from Mattafix's debut album, Signs of a Struggle.

title: “Hung Up” by 4 November
text: "Hung Up" is a song by American singer Madonna from her tenth studio album Confessions on a Dance Floor. Initially used in a number of television advertisements and serials, the song was released as the album's lead single on October 17, 2005.
